decision.explanation: The question asks what language(s) are associated with the work or name of *Data retention in the telecommunications field: analysis of its regulation in the European Union and its fit into EU Law*. Document d1 provides strong evidence that the thesis is written in **Spanish**, citing both the academic institution (Universidad Carlos III de Madrid) and the Spanish title of the thesis. Document d2, however, refers to an in-depth analysis of the same topic being conducted in **English**, and mentions the English-language title of the thesis. These two documents describe the same work but attribute different languages to it based on context—d1 describes the actual thesis, while d2 refers to a separate English-language analysis of the topic. Both assertions are valid and refer to distinct linguistic versions or perspectives of the same subject. Therefore, both 'Spanish' and 'English' are retained as correct answers.
